description: This file declares structures and function prototypes for managing dynamic arrays and associated data types such as strings and integers within the lighttpd server project. It defines array operations, data types, and method tables used internally for configuration and data handling.

methods.name: array_data_string_init
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new data_string object.

methods.name: array_data_array_init
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new data_array object.

methods.name: array_data_integer_init
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new data_integer object.

methods.name: array_init
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new array with a specified size.

methods.name: array_copy_array
methods.description: Copies data from source array to destination array.

methods.name: array_free_data
methods.description: Frees the data contained within an array.

methods.name: array_free
methods.description: Frees the entire array structure.

methods.name: array_reset_data_strings
methods.description: Resets string data within the array.

methods.name: array_insert_unique
methods.description: Inserts data_unset entry into the array if it does not exist already.

methods.name: array_pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the last element from a simple list array.

methods.name: array_is_vlist
methods.description: Checks if array is a value list (sequence).

methods.name: array_is_kvany
methods.description: Checks if array is a key-value array with any key type.

methods.name: array_is_kvarray
methods.description: Checks if array has key-value pairs with string keys.

methods.name: array_is_kvstring
methods.description: Checks if array contains string keys and string values.

methods.name: array_get_element_klen_ext
methods.description: Retrieves an element from array by key with extension and key length.

methods.name: array_get_element_klen
methods.description: Retrieves an element from array by key and key length.

methods.name: array_get_data_unset
methods.description: Retrieves data_unset element by key.

methods.name: array_extract_element_klen
methods.description: Removes and returns an element from the array by key.

methods.name: array_get_int_ptr
methods.description: Retrieves pointer to integer value associated with key.

methods.name: array_get_buf_ptr_ext
methods.description: Retrieves pointer to buffer associated with key and extension.

methods.name: array_get_buf_ptr
methods.description: Retrieves pointer to buffer associated with key.

methods.name: array_insert_value
methods.description: Inserts a string value into the array.

methods.name: void array_set_key_value(array * const a,const char * const k,const uint32_t klen,const char * const v,const uint32_t vlen)
methods.description: Sets key-value pair in array, copying strings.

methods.name: array_replace
methods.description: Replaces data at an array entry with a new one.

methods.name: array_match_key_prefix_klen
methods.description: Matches array elements with key prefix given key and length.

methods.name: array_match_key_prefix_nc_klen
methods.description: Case-insensitive key prefix matching.

methods.name: array_match_key_prefix
methods.description: Matches key prefix with a buffer.

methods.name: array_match_key_prefix_nc
methods.description: Case-insensitive prefix match with buffer.

methods.name: array_match_value_prefix
methods.description: Matches value with prefix.

methods.name: array_match_value_prefix_nc
methods.description: Case-insensitive value prefix match.

methods.name: array_match_key_suffix
methods.description: Matches key suffix.

methods.name: array_match_key_suffix_nc
methods.description: Case-insensitive key suffix match.

methods.name: array_match_value_suffix
methods.description: Matches value suffix.

methods.name: array_match_value_suffix_nc
methods.description: Case-insensitive value suffix match.

methods.name: array_match_path_or_ext
methods.description: Matches path or extension within array.
